The famous Merode Altarpiece triptych, for instance, shows the Virigin reading in a dining room, unaware of the Archangel, while Joseph makes mousetraps in hisworkshop The Virgin and Child beforea Firescreen,ow thought tobe the workofa follower rather than Campin himself, also presents the Virgin in a domestic interior.
